summary: CBL International Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing a 1-for-13 reverse share consolidation of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective July 20, 2026. The consolidation is intended to regain compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price rule. No fractional shares will be issued; instead, fractional shares will be rounded up. All shareholders are uniformly affected, with no change in percentage ownership except for fractional share adjustments. The consolidation was approved by shareholders at an EGM on November 26, 2025, and by the board on June 23, 2026. This is a routine corporate action to meet exchange listing requirements, not a special situation.
